I have experience developing Focus grow, an AI-powered focus application helping to keep mental health. I bring skills in coding, AI tools, teamwork, and creative thinking. I want to use NASA satellite data to develop innovative solutions to mental health issues of the astronauts.
summary:
GROW is a wellbeing and self-monitoring application designed to support astronauts' mental and behavioral health during long-duration space missions.

It combines focus tracking, guided breathing exercises, journaling, daily progress monitoring, and a virtual growth companion called Jelly to encourage healthy routines. By tracking focus sessions, activity patterns, and personal reflections, astronauts can become more aware of their wellbeing and daily habits.

The application aims to address challenges associated with isolation, confinement, and psychological stress in space. Its goal is to make personal wellbeing monitoring simple, engaging, and accessible, encouraging astronauts to maintain healthier routines throughout their missions.
details: GROW – A Wellbeing Companion for Astronauts GROW is a wellbeing and self-monitoring application designed to support astronauts' mental and behavioural health during long-duration space missions. Space missions can involve isolation, confinement, demanding schedules and psychological stress. GROW aims to make daily wellbeing management more accessible, engaging and consistent. The application works as a personal wellbeing companion through several interactive features. Its Focus Timer helps users structure their work sessions and maintain concentration. Guided breathing exercises offer short relaxation breaks, while the journaling feature allows users to record their thoughts, feelings and daily experiences. Progress tracking helps users reflect on their routines and activity patterns. Another distinctive feature is Jelly, a virtual growth companion that encourages users to maintain consistency and develop healthy habits. The Study Hub can also provide access to useful learning materials and reference resources. The main benefit of GROW is that it encourages astronauts to become more aware of their daily habits and emotional wellbeing. Rather than making wellbeing monitoring feel like another demanding task, it presents it through simple, interactive and motivating activities. Our intended impact is to support healthier routines, encourage self-reflection and contribute to better psychological wellbeing during extended missions. What makes GROW creative is its combination of productivity tools, emotional self-reflection, relaxation exercises and gamification in one application. The virtual companion, Jelly, makes consistency more engaging by connecting personal progress with a sense of growth. We considered the challenges of limited time, isolation, accessibility, ease of use and the importance of making the application simple enough to fit into an astronaut's daily routine. For development, we worked with Visual Studio Code (VS Code) as our coding environment, Python for programming, and GitHub for code management and version control. We also worked with Flutter, Dart and the Android SDK as part of our development setup. These tools helped us work on the application's development, organization and testing. GROW is currently a software-based prototype. Its features focus on user-entered information and behavioural activity tracking. It does not independently measure vital signs, diagnose medical conditions or replace professional medical monitoring. In the future, it could be expanded through secure integration with approved health-monitoring devices and mission health systems. Ultimately, GROW aims to show that supporting astronaut health is not only about monitoring physical indicators but also about encouraging mental wellbeing, self-awareness and healthy daily habits.
